# Health Data Management: Parkview Health aims to enhance efficiency with archiving solutions

Parkview Health encountered challenges in merging systems from various healthcare organizations. By selecting Harmony Healthcare IT’s HealthData Archiver®, they established a centralized repository that enhanced data retrieval and compliance while improving patient care and reducing inefficiencies.
